gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Noto Sans Tagbanwa keeps its curves open and its lowercase tall, filling most of the line. Autour One above it draws every stroke in one unbroken line, so Noto Sans Tagbanwa feels like the quieter, more spacious half.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le tapers its strokes out before they touch. Autour One does the opposite, a bold thread of ink with no swelling, while Noto Sans Tai Le is better at staying quiet and approachable.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Expressive Autour One holds a single skeleton weight through every letter, with a clear channel leading into each round shape. Noto Sans Tai Tham follows with crowded, chalk-board lowercase you can read right into.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Autour One keeps curves and stems moving in lockstep, bold and expressive. Noto Sans Tai Viet then settles in with short ascenders and a tall x-height, so the text feels approachable and easy to follow.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-takri: Round, confident and bold, Autour One draws each glyph with one single-width stroke. And Noto Sans Takri brings generously unclosed curves on its small round letters, which is the sharpest contrast here.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-thai-l: Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters that never seem to pinch shut, with a pronounced x-height. And Noto Sans Thai Looped sits underneath with tall, spacious lowercase that looks bold without being heavy.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Audiowide has a futuristic, drawn-wire feel, with glyphs spaced like tiles with wide grout lines. Noto Sans Tangsa supplies the approachable counterpart, with wide, inviting round letters and short ascender stems.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Dark and aggressive, Eater sets thin strokes beside moderately weighty stems, with wide gaps between its letters. Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified, so a modest size will do.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supplemen: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement has round forms like open parentheses and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky. Flavors is whimsical and commanding, with glyphs that look cut from equal strips.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Noto Sans Telugu sets its midline high and keeps counters connected to the outside. Autour One has the constant weight of a stencil-cut channel, so Noto Sans Telugu gives the pair its professional, level-headed side.
